description: First frozen eval suite. All arms are mirror-deck so they run under run_batch.py cited discipline TODAY (cited forbids asymmetric decks; asymmetric student-deck-vs-AI-deck matchups are deferred to the orchestration workstream, which will add a cited-nomirror mode with both deck SHAs pinned). Identity A is always the student (controller llm, model ${STUDENT}); identity B is the arm opponent. Headline metric per arm: paired win rate of identity A with Wilson 95% CI (aggregate.py). Sanity arms exist to catch harness regressions cheaply before spending on the 200-pair arms.

seed_policy.note: Eval-only bank, declared here until the seed-registry workstream lands its own artifact; when it does, this range MUST be moved under it and the overlap check wired to datasets/*/meta.jsonl. Per-arm ranges below are disjoint; gaps left for future arms.

gates_note: max_fallback_rate is enforced by aggregate.py. defect_invariants = defect_analyzer.py must exit 0 over each arm's output dir. min_autonomy_pct is a placeholder for the autonomy metric (provenance workstream item 3); set a number once game lines carry it.

arms.name: floor-sanity
arms.note: Harness smoke: student must crush floor. 10 pairs is plenty for an expected blowout. Caveat: floor short-circuits before the play/attack/block menus, so this certifies little about real decision paths.

arms.name: random-sanity
arms.note: Second rung: random plays the real menus, so unlike floor it exercises the full decision surface from the opposing seat.

arms.name: forge-ai-ur-delver
arms.note: Headline arm, in-distribution deck (ur-delver is in every corpus since stage1). 200 pairs matches the repo power math for a 10-pt gap at rho~0.5. Reference: Forge-AI-vs-Forge-AI ceiling on this deck is 28% (runs/stage2-eval/ai-delver-ceiling).

arms.name: forge-ai-burn
arms.note: Second in-distribution deck so the headline is not one matchup. Burn is the most-represented deck in stage2 corpora.

arms.name: forge-ai-painter
arms.note: Generalization arm. painter is HELD-OUT in eval/holdouts.json, but grandfathered through stage2-local-v1-dagger: for the current student this measures a low-training-exposure deck, NOT a clean one. It becomes a true generalization number for any model trained on corpora built after the 2026-07-26 holdout declaration (check_holdouts.py enforces).

arms.name: teacher-mirror
arms.note: Student vs frozen teacher (e.g. opus, or a pinned earlier checkpoint) on a mirror deck: the purest pilot-skill delta the design supports. Disabled until a teacher model spec is chosen and frozen; pass --teacher SPEC to run_suite.py when enabling.
